[PyLangParser] new implementation of text parser

- generic parser
  - TextWalker, by default cut tokens by punctuations.
  - skipString can be used to cut a source code string
    with escape support like "abc" "\n" "\""
  - skipLongString can be used to cut more things like
    "hello" """ test """ /* comment */

e.g.
with open('code.py', 'r') as f:
  text = f.read()
walker = TextWalker(text)
for onecut in walker:
  if onecut[1] == '"' or onecut[1] == "'":
    stop = onecut[1]
    if walker.seeForward(2) == stop * 2:
      print "LONG STRING:", walker.skipLongString(stop*3)
    else:
      print "STRING:", walker.skipString()
  else:
    print onecut
